title: Look ahead
goal: Add a, b and cin, settled within 7 ns: quicker than a ripple of four FAs. FA is a full adder. LA is a carry lookahead block: given two columns of a and b and their carry in, it works out their carry out at once.
hint: the sum is only as quick as the carry that reaches the top. Let it get there without passing through every box on the way.
